pattern.top_pattern: CA authorization bucket shift needs validation before action
key_driver_codes: Degenerative Nervous System Disorders with MCC
pattern.pattern_details: California shows the same authorization distribution issue seen in Florida, but concentrated in neurologic and back-related inpatient groupings. Because the movement sits in an authorization bucket, it should be treated as a validation issue before interpreting it as true service growth or payment pressure.
pattern.why_it_matters: California inpatient follow-up could be misdirected if these claims moved buckets instead of truly worsening.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Validate California authorization mapping and any auth workflow changes first, then release confirmed claims for UM and reimbursement review by service line.
pattern.validation_reason: The spend movement is explicitly flagged as an auth or mapping shift that requires validation before business action.
evidence_summary: Degenerative Nervous System Disorders with MCC accounts for +$12.3M of the shift.
Medical Back Problems without MCC adds another +$6.0M.
